description: List or create Data tables, delete a table, and list, query, get, create, batch-create, update, or delete records on a Data project this account owns. list_records accepts the same filter, search, order, and cursor as the project Data API and applies them to the latest 250 rows. list_changes polls records updated after since. Field changes stay in the Data app. This is not a websocket, Supabase Realtime, Auth, or Edge Functions. Private files are the files tool.

cursor.description: list_records cursor from next_cursor. Do not combine with offset.

data.description: One record for create_record, or a field patch for update_record.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional update_record check. Must match the record updated_at you read.

filter.description: list_records field name. Send op and value with it.

limit.description: list_records page size, from 1 to 100. Default 100.

offset.description: list_records offset, from 0 to 249. Do not combine with cursor.

order.description: list_records sort: id, created_at, updated_at, or field:NAME. Default created_at.

q.description: list_records text search across the record id and JSON.

records.description: Batch of 1 to 250 records for create_record. Do not also send data.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for list_changes. Returns rows with a later updated_at. This is a poll, not a websocket.

value.description: list_records filter value. Booleans are true or false. Empty checks omit value.

name: database
title: Database
